name: Chainback
summary: A heavy, shelled pursuer with rusted chains grown into its back.

sections.title: Rank and Class
sections.text: Usually an Awakened Monster: two soul cores, two shards. Monsters use the ground they fight on and come back after retreating.

sections.title: Habits
sections.text: Climbs cliffs and walls to follow you. Its chain pull winds up with a rattle and a line of rust in the air, then yanks its target toward it, often off a ledge.

sections.title: Weakness
sections.text: Break line of sight during the wind-up and the chain falls short. It is too wide for one-block gaps, so a narrow passage beats it.

sections.title: Drops
sections.text: Chainback Links (one to three) for Chainback Mail and the Linked Cleaver, and its soul shards.
